newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Oil to sell mixed xylene to Mitsubishi Corp.
newsitem.headline: Thai Oil to sell mixed xylene to Mitsubishi Corp.

text.p: Thai Oil Co Ltd has signed an agreement to sell 150,000-200,000 tonnes of mixed xylenes annually to Mitsubishi Corp, a company official said Thursday.
The contract covered an initial period of two years, with the product ready for lifting in February 1997.
The product is produced from the company's 220,000-barrels-per day refinery in Sriracha.
Mixed xylenes are normally used as feedstock for the production of paraxylene which in turn is raw material for producing PTA whcih is used in the production of polyester and drinking water bottles.
